Our SLA countdown on a ticket looks wrong, it doesn't match what I'd expect.
Let's dig in. Can you share the ticket number?
It's TKT reference I can find in my dashboard, one moment.
No rush. In the meantime, is business-hours-only SLA calculation enabled on your account? That can make the countdown look different from a straight 24-hour clock.

Our CRM integration seems to have stopped syncing.
Sorry about that. Could you check the status shown under Admin Dashboard > Integrations for that connection?
It says 'Error' status.
That usually means the authentication token has expired. Try reauthorizing the connection from that same screen — it should just take a minute.
I'm unable to log in after resetting my password.
Sorry about that — let's get this sorted. Can you confirm the email address on your account?

Okay, trying that now... that worked, thank you!
Glad to hear it! Let me know if you run into anything else.
I'm trying to set up a webhook but I'm not sure I'm doing it right.
Happy to walk through it. Have you created the endpoint under Admin Dashboard > API Platform > Webhooks yet?
Yes, but I'm not seeing any test events come through.
Let's check a couple things — is your endpoint publicly reachable, and does it return a 200 status quickly? Also confirm the event type you expect is included in the subscription.
We need to add a few new agents to our account.
Happy to help point you in the right direction! As an administrator, you can invite new users directly from Admin Dashboard > Users > Invite User.
One of our agents isn't getting push notifications on the mobile app.
Let's troubleshoot. Has this agent checked that notifications are enabled for the app at the device level, not just within the app itself?
Good question, let me check with them.
Also worth checking whether battery optimization settings might be restricting background activity for the app.
Turns out notifications were disabled at the device level. Fixed now, thanks!
Glad that resolved it! Happy to help if anything else comes up.
